lambda x, d, c: x < c.val * d.val if d.val > 0 else x > c.val * d.val if d.val < 0 else None
lambda x, c1, y: x + y + c1 if y.op is not Ops.CONST else None
lambda x, c1, y: x * y * c1 if y.op is not Ops.CONST else None
lambda x, c: lt_folding(x, c.val) if 0 < c.val else None
lambda x: (newx < 1).ne(True) if (newx := canonicalize_simplex(x)) is not None else None
lambda x, a, b: x.cast(b.dtype) if can_lossless_cast(x.dtype, a.dtype) else None
lambda x, a, b: x.ccast(b.dtype) if not x.overflows(a.dtype) else None

rules.pattern: UPat(GroupOp.Binary, src=(UPat.var('x', (dtypes.long, dtypes.weakint)), UPat.var('y', (dtypes.long, dtypes.weakint))), name='u')
rules.callback: lambda u, x, y: (UOp.const(x.val) if x.op is Ops.CONST else x.cast(dtypes.int)).alu(u.op, UOp.const(y.val) if y.op is Ops.CONST else y.cast(dtypes.int)).cast(u.dtype) if dtypes.long in (x.dtype, y.dtype) and (not any((v.overflows(dtypes.int) for v in (u, x, y)))) else None
lambda x, c, cast: x.cast(cast.dtype) + cast.const_like(c.val)
lambda x: x.replace(src=(x.src[0],) + tuple(dedup(flatten([(y,) if y.op in {Ops.RANGE, Ops.STORE, Ops.CALL, Ops.BARRIER, Ops.END, Ops.LINEAR, Ops.STAGE} else y.src for y in x.src[1:]]))))
lambda x: x.replace(src=(x.src[0],) + tuple((r for r in x.src[1:] if r.op is not Ops.CONST or r.dtype is dtypes.bool)))
lambda cond, buf, idx, or_cast: where_on_load(cond.logical_not(), buf, idx, or_cast)
lambda root: UOp(root.op, src=tuple(flatten((x.src if x.op in REMOVE_FROM_SINK_LIKE else (x,) for x in root.src))), arg=root.arg) if any((x.op in REMOVE_FROM_SINK_LIKE for x in root.src)) else None
lambda index, cond, val, i: UOp.store(index.src[0].index(index.src[1].valid(cond)), val)
lambda x, y, d: y * (1 - d)
lambda x, y, d: 1 - d + x * y
lambda x, y, c: x * c + y * c

rules.pattern: UPat(Ops.CUSTOM, src=(UPat(Ops.AND, src=UPat(Ops.CUSTOMI), name='x'), UPat(), UPat()), name='r')
rules.callback: lambda r, x: r.replace(src=(UOp(Ops.CUSTOMI, arg=('(' + ' and '.join((y.arg[0] for y in x.src)) + ')', dtypes.void)),) + r.src[1:])
lambda x: UOp(Ops.CUSTOMI, arg=(x.arg[0].format(*[y.arg[0] for y in x.src]), dtypes.void))

rules.pattern: UPat(Ops.INDEX, src=(UPat(Ops.CUSTOMI, name='x'), UPat(Ops.CONST, name='c')), name='g')
rules.callback: lambda x, c, g: x.replace(arg=(x.arg[0] + f'.src[{c.val}]', dtypes.void))
lambda x, cond, ctx: ctx[0].add(ctx[1][cond]) or ctx[1][x]
lambda x, ctx: create_bounded(x.arg if x.op is Ops.SPECIAL else f'r{range_str(x)}', 0, ctx[1][x.src[0]] - 1, ctx[0])
lambda c, x, ctx: (ctx[1][x] - c.dtype.min) % 2 ** (8 * c.dtype.itemsize) + c.dtype.min
lambda x, ctx: z3.BoolVal(x.val, ctx=ctx[0].ctx) if x.dtype == dtypes.bool else z3.IntVal(x.val, ctx=ctx[0].ctx)
lambda c, x, ctx: z3_cast(c, ctx[1][x])
lambda x, ctx: z3_alu[x.op](*(ctx[1][s] for s in x.src))

rules.pattern: UPat((Ops.INDEX, Ops.SHRINK), src=(UPat.var('buf'), UPat.var('gate').where(UPat.var('idx', dtypes.long), UPat(Ops.CONST, arg=Invalid))), allow_any_len=True, name='u')
rules.callback: lambda u, buf, gate, idx: u.replace(src=(buf, idx.cast(dtypes.int).valid(gate)) + u.src[2:]) if buf.max_numel() - 1 <= dtypes.int32.max else None

rules.pattern: UPat(Ops.CAST, dtype=dtypes.weaks, src=(UPat(Ops.CAST, dtype=dtypes.weaks, src=(UPat.var('x'),)),), name='u')
rules.callback: lambda u, x: x.cast(u.src[0].commit_dtype(dtypes.int)).cast(u.commit_dtype(dtypes.int)).cast(u.dtype) if x.dtype not in dtypes.weaks else None
lambda u: u.replace(arg=replace(u.arg, dtype=u.commit_dtype(dtypes.int))).cast(dtypes.weakint) if u.addrspace == AddrSpace.ALU else None
